data.name: Abrarunnisa
data.gender_notes: Abrarunnisa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Abrarunnisa is a beautiful Islamic name of Arabic origin, derived from the Quranic word 'Abirun' which means 'the radiant'. The female form of this name, Abrarunnisa, signifies a servant of Allah who is radiant with faith and good deeds. The name Abrarunnisa carries the meaning “Servant of Allah, the Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abrarunnisa usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah, the radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A servant of Allah, radiating with faith and righteousness.
data.etymology: Abrarunnisa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Allah, the Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abrarunnisa total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_urdu.name: ابرارونیسا

in_urdu.long_meaning: ابرارونیسا نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سچا اور راستباز، اور نيسا کا مطلب سيدة یا عورت، لہذا یہ نام سچائی اور نیک نیتی والی عورت کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_pashto.name: ابرارونیسا
